title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (Windows, tree-actions) shard fails with generic exit code 1, unrelated to PR changes
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, tree-actions)
error_pattern: Process completed with exit code 1. Timed out after 10000ms waiting for E2E control revision <timestamp>. Occurs both in the main test ('routes view, copy, endpoint, log, and resource commands through tree handlers') and its teardown 'after each' hook.
analysis: The 'Aspire tree action command E2E routes view, copy, endpoint, log, and resource commands through tree handlers' test timed out waiting for an E2E control state revision after 10000ms during a Windows CI run. The PR only modifies the Aspire skills bundle and telemetry hook scripts, not the VS Code extension's tree action or E2E control infrastructure, so this is a timing-related flake unrelated to the PR.
